fullText.simplified:
十、新天地

    柳毅回到家，母亲十分高兴。虽然他没有通过考试，但母亲一点儿都不难过。
    “我的好儿子，没关系，明年还可以去考。我相信你，一定可以通过考试的。”母亲说。
    柳毅心里的难过一下子就没有了。他抱着母亲，流着泪笑了。
    柳毅打扫了自己的房间，把书桌上的书全部整理了一次。晚上，他坐在干净的书桌前，打开一本书，开始认真地看了起来。柳毅是爱学习的，他很快就进入了书里的世界。他白天看书，晚上看书，一本接一本地看，像是进入了新天地。
    学习的快乐让他忘记了很多事。慢慢地，龙宫、龙女、龙王……都离他远去了。
    很快，一年过去了。
    秋天，柳毅第二次去京城参加考试。这一次他准备得很好，考得不错，通过了考试。他得到了一份工作，去京城做官。他带着母亲，把家从洞庭搬到了京城。
    柳毅是个善良的人，当然也是个好官。他工作认真，亲民爱民，大家都很喜欢他。
    又过去了三年。现在柳毅二十七岁了。很多人二十七岁都当爸爸了，但柳毅还没有结婚。母亲很着急，很多人都来给他介绍好姑娘，希望他找个好妻子。虽然柳毅对结婚一点儿兴趣都没有，但大家都太热情了，他没办法拒绝。他听他们的话，去见了一些姑娘。姑娘们有的很漂亮，有的读了很多书，有的很会做饭，还有的很会画画。他却好像都不喜欢。他和她们聊天，聊着聊着就没有话说了。
    后来，他不去见大家给他介绍的姑娘了。他觉得没有妻子也不是什么坏事，一个人过也不错。但是母亲不这么想，她还在坚持给他找好姑娘。
    这天早上，母亲高兴地和他说：“我昨天见了一位姑娘，性格、样子都十分好，就是以前结过婚，不知道你愿不愿意见见？”
    柳毅笑着问：“以前结过婚，是她的丈夫对她不好吗？”
    母亲说：“不知道丈夫对她好不好，只听说她丈夫结婚没多久就生病死了。丈夫死后，她就回了自己母亲家，在母亲家已经住了四年了。”
    柳毅听了，不说话。母亲以为他不喜欢，就说：“好吧，结过婚的姑娘，你不喜欢就不喜欢吧。我再看看有没有别的好姑娘。”
    没想到柳毅却说：“我去见见这位姑娘。她叫什么名字？”
    母亲高兴极了，说：“她姓林，叫林思思。”
fullText.traditional:
十、新天地

    柳毅回到家，母親十分高興。雖然他沒有通過考試，但母親一點兒都不難過。
    “我的好兒子，沒關係，明年還可以去考。我相信你，一定可以通過考試的。”母親說。
    柳毅心裡的難過一下子就沒有了。他抱著母親，流著淚笑了。
    柳毅打掃了自己的房間，把書桌上的書全部整理了一次。晚上，他坐在乾淨的書桌前，打開一本書，開始認真地看了起來。柳毅是愛學習的，他很快就進入了書裡的世界。他白天看書，晚上看書，一本接一本地看，像是進入了新天地。
    學習的快樂讓他忘記了很多事。慢慢地，龍宮、龍女、龍王……都離他遠去了。
    很快，一年過去了。
    秋天，柳毅第二次去京城參加考試。這一次他準備得很好，考得不錯，通過了考試。他得到了一份工作，去京城做官。他帶著母親，把家從洞庭搬到了京城。
    柳毅是個善良的人，當然也是個好官。他工作認真，親民愛民，大家都很喜歡他。
    又過去了三年。現在柳毅二十七歲了。很多人二十七歲都當爸爸了，但柳毅還沒有結婚。母親很著急，很多人都來給他介紹好姑娘，希望他找個好妻子。雖然柳毅對結婚一點兒興趣都沒有，但大家都太熱情了，他沒辦法拒絕。他聽他們的話，去見了一些姑娘。姑娘們有的很漂亮，有的讀了很多書，有的很會做飯，還有的很會畫畫。他卻好像都不喜歡。他和她們聊天，聊著聊著就沒有話說了。
    後來，他不去見大家給他介紹的姑娘了。他覺得沒有妻子也不是什麼壞事，一個人過也不錯。但是母親不這麼想，她還在堅持給他找好姑娘。
    這天早上，母親高興地和他說：“我昨天見了一位姑娘，性格、樣子都十分好，就是以前結過婚，不知道你願不願意見見？”
    柳毅笑著問：“以前結過婚，是她的丈夫對她不好嗎？”
    母親說：“不知道丈夫對她好不好，只聽說她丈夫結婚沒多久就生病死了。丈夫死後，她就回了自己母親家，在母親家已經住了四年了。”
    柳毅聽了，不說話。母親以為他不喜歡，就說：“好吧，結過婚的姑娘，你不喜歡就不喜歡吧。我再看看有沒有別的好姑娘。”
    沒想到柳毅卻說：“我去見見這位姑娘。她叫什麼名字？”
    母親高興極了，說：“她姓林，叫林思思。”

sentences.simplified: “好吧，结过婚的姑娘，你不喜欢就不喜欢吧。我再看看有没有别的好姑娘。”
sentences.traditional: “好吧，結過婚的姑娘，你不喜歡就不喜歡吧。我再看看有沒有別的好姑娘。”
sentences.pinyin: hǎo ba jié guò hūn de gū niang nǐ bù xǐ huan jiù bù xǐ huan ba wǒ zài kàn kan yǒu méi yǒu bié de hǎo gū niang
sentences.english: .. “Alright, if you don’t like girls who have been married before, so be it. I’ll see if there are any other good girls.”

sentences.simplified: 没想到柳毅却说：“我去见见这位姑娘。她叫什么名字？”
sentences.traditional: 沒想到柳毅卻說：“我去見見這位姑娘。她叫什麼名字？”
sentences.pinyin: méi xiǎng dào liǔ yì què shuō wǒ qù jiàn jiàn zhè wèi gū niang tā jiào shén me míng zi
sentences.english: Unexpectedly, Liu Yi said, “I’ll go meet this girl. What’s her name?”

sentences.simplified: 母亲高兴极了，说：“她姓林，叫林思思。”
sentences.traditional: 母親高興極了，說：“她姓林，叫林思思。”
sentences.pinyin: mǔ qīn gāo xìng jí le shuō tā xìng lín jiào lín sī sī
sentences.english: His mother was extremely happy and said, “Her surname is Lin, and her name is Lin Sisi.”

sentence_translations: 10. A New World
When Liu Yi returned home, his mother was extremely happy.
Although he hadn’t passed the exam, his mother was not upset at all.
“My good son, it’s okay. You can take the exam again next year.
I believe in you. You’ll be able to pass the exam for sure,” his mother said.
The sadness in Liu Yi’s heart suddenly disappeared. He hugged his mother, smiling through his tears.
Liu Yi cleaned his room and organized all the books on his desk.
In the evening, he sat at the clean desk, opened a book, and began to read it attentively.
Liu Yi loved studying, and he quickly immersed himself in the world of his books.
During the day, he read books. At night, he read books.
Reading one book after another, it was as if he had stepped into a whole new world.
The joy of learning helped him forget many things.
Slowly, the Dragon Palace, Longnü, the Dragon King … all faded away from him.
Soon, a year had passed.
That autumn, Liu Yi went to the capital to take the exam for the second time.
This time, he was very well-prepared. He did well on the exam and passed.
He got a job, serving as an official in the capital.
He took his mother with him and moved their home from Dongting to the capital.
Liu Yi was a kindhearted person, and of course, he was also a good official.
He worked diligently, was close to the people and cared for them, and everyone liked him very much.
Another three years passed. Liu Yi was now twenty-seven years old.
By the age of twenty-seven, many people were already fathers, but Liu Yi was still unmarried.
His mother grew very anxious, and many people came to introduce good young ladies to him, hoping he would find a good wife.
Although Liu Yi had no interest in marriage whatsoever, everyone was so enthusiastic that he couldn’t refuse.
He listened to them and went to meet a few young ladies.
Some of the young ladies were very beautiful, some had read a lot of books, ..
.. some were very good at cooking, and still others were very good at painting.
Yet he didn’t seem to like any of them. After chatting with them for a while, there was nothing left to say.
Later, he stopped meeting the young ladies that others introduced to him.
He felt that not having a wife wasn’t such a bad thing and that living alone was actually quite fine.
However, his mother didn’t think that way. She still insisted on finding a good girl for him.
That morning, his mother happily said to him:
“Yesterday I met a girl. Her personality and appearance are both excellent, but she has been married before.
I wonder if you would be willing to meet her?”
Liu Yi asked with a smile, “She was married before, was it that her husband treated her poorly?”
His mother said, “I don’t know if her husband treated her well.
I only heard that her husband fell ill and died not long after they got married.
After her husband died, she returned to her mother’s home. She has been living at her mother’s home for four years.”
Liu Yi listened and said nothing.
His mother thought he didn’t like the idea, so she said, ..
.. “Alright, if you don’t like girls who have been married before, so be it. I’ll see if there are any other good girls.”
Unexpectedly, Liu Yi said, “I’ll go meet this girl. What’s her name?”
His mother was extremely happy and said, “Her surname is Lin, and her name is Lin Sisi.”
